display_name: Phase1 多候选源域留出互补性诊断
description: 固定 DURA、盲保护识别指导恢复和盲保护困难样本恢复，先封存 RX8/day3 同记录源预测，再读取合法 L_s 标签并计算候选修复损伤。
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发新的 Phase1 星地恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI Python GPU2 if free; two CPU threads

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: float32 IQ [2,256]; source L_s/U_s paired clean and simulated post_sync residual channel
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: Six registered Phase1 TX; no TX labels used in training or source IQ selection
data.validation_ref: 3921 fixed RX8/day3 source L_s/U_s IDs, excluded gate/student training; identities and other channel views previously inspected; no V
data.leo_config_ref: Source cache epoch18 seven simulated scenes

permissions.query_use: No target IQ or target labels; no V or Phase3. Source L_s labels read only after all predictions sealed.
permissions.claim_scope: Exploratory single-seed source-only comparison; source identities seen by historical ground F and previous views

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen matched DURA, source-selected semantic blind gate, source-selected labeled-curriculum blind gate, frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL; no training
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: core.data matches source IDs to exact Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: No model selection or training; report fixed candidate repair/damage and nondeployable label-aided union only

execution.launch_owner: Codex source multicandidate diagnostic single owner
execution.gpu_policy: GPU2 only if idle; one worker and two CPU threads
execution.launch_command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 MKL_NUM_THREADS=2 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=2 PYTHONPATH=/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261101-phase1-physical-rich-router-s2026092701-r01-release:/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261027-phase1-pamf-repl-shuffled-views-m16-r02-release /home/szu2070436088/.conda/envs/CVS-RFFI/bin/python -X utf8 -u /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261102-diagnostic-phase1-multicandidate-source-s2026092701-r01-release/experiments/phase1_source_multicandidate/phase1_source_multicandidate.py --root /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet --out /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/runs/20261102-diagnostic-phase1-multicandidate-source-s2026092701-r01 --commit 5aafeacfea6f83638a5e5967a527416f7e9c98e5 --device cuda:0
execution.stop_rule: Only provenance/role violation, output collision, nonfinite or technical execution failure; preserve all partial outputs; no stop for low performance

metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Oracle union uses true or pseudo targets unavailable at inference; limited to fixed candidates and source records.

rows.method: fixed IQ restorers with frozen ground classifier, no fitting or routing
rows.seed_notes: No new random sampling, training, or hyperparameter search; fixed source RX8/day3 IDs and cache epoch18
rows.budget_ref: 3921 same-record source heldout IQ; labels only after fixed predictions
rows.command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 MKL_NUM_THREADS=2 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=2 PYTHONPATH=/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261101-phase1-physical-rich-router-s2026092701-r01-release:/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261027-phase1-pamf-repl-shuffled-views-m16-r02-release /home/szu2070436088/.conda/envs/CVS-RFFI/bin/python -X utf8 -u /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261102-diagnostic-phase1-multicandidate-source-s2026092701-r01-release/experiments/phase1_source_multicandidate/phase1_source_multicandidate.py --root /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet --out /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/runs/20261102-diagnostic-phase1-multicandidate-source-s2026092701-r01 --commit 5aafeacfea6f83638a5e5967a527416f7e9c98e5 --device cuda:0

notes: Predictions sealed before legitimate L_s labels are read; U_s truth never opened.
